details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K4, K7 and K8 are fully represented. K3 is only partially covered (EPS-Sterna order and INFLECION mentioned, but ESA co-funding and SEK 350 M programme details omitted). K5 is entirely missing (Bonnier Capital investment). K6 is only partially covered (recurring maritime data revenues noted, but AI-enhanced services and vertical-integration strategy not addressed).
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence follows logically from the preceding ones: the opening statement of weakened performance (S1) is supported by the quantified revenue, EBITDA and earnings declines (S2–S5), which are then attributed to specific segment and programme issues (S6–S8). The contrasting positive performance of the Data & Services segment (S9–S10) is clearly distinguished. Cash-flow deterioration (S11–S12) is presented as a direct consequence of the operating results, while the subsequent statements on equity, liquidity and financing (S13–S14) logically address the balance-sheet position. The outlook section (S15–S17) follows naturally from the year-end results and is internally consistent. No self-contradictions, logical gaps, organisational problems or unnecessary repetitions are present.
